claims.claim: Equinix's SEC-filed Q2 2026 release reported 11% year-over-year monthly recurring revenue growth, 23% growth in annualized gross bookings, record backlog and 9,700 net interconnection additions; its 10-Q reports roughly 78% cabinet utilization and rising per-cabinet power demand associated with AI adoption.

risks.risk: Growth in high-density AI workloads increases dependence on timely power, cooling and new-capacity delivery in constrained markets.

unknowns.unknown: Current filings do not isolate the share of incremental bookings economically attributable to AI versus broader cloud/network demand.

claims.claim: Q2 operating indicators support execution against expanding digital-infrastructure demand, while the 10-Q explicitly identifies power/cooling intensity and capacity delivery as constraints that can limit growth in selected markets.

risks.risk: Power infrastructure delays can decouple demand from monetizable capacity.
